sharedSpecification.assetType: production animation sprite-sheet master for a dark sci-fi 2D side-scroller
sharedSpecification.grid: exactly 5 horizontal rows by exactly 6 equal columns, one identity per row
sharedSpecification.style: original dark sci-fi pixel-painted game art with crisp readable silhouettes and detailed hand-painted pixel clusters
sharedSpecification.backdrop: perfectly flat uniform solid #ff00ff chroma-key background
sharedSpecification.invariants: same anatomy, scale, colors and equipment across all six cells of a row; only pose changes; full bodies visible; generous padding; no overlap
sharedSpecification.avoid: text, labels, UI, borders, grid lines, icons, duplicate subjects, merged frames, cropped anatomy, cast shadows, contact shadows, scenery, watermark, logo

rows.anatomyPrompt: A heavy alien herbivore quadruped with low shoulders, broad grazer muzzle, four weight-bearing legs, and living vines and leaves densely rooted across its armored back.
A small low-slung alien reptile with four short gripping limbs, curled tail, prominent turret eye, and faceted prismatic mirror scales.
A robust alien primate with barrel chest, long powerful forearms, shorter bent legs, heavy knuckles and faint bioelectric nodes; never human-shaped.
A squat toxic alien frog with four splayed amphibian limbs, broad head, inflated throat sac and visible rigid needle spines along back and thighs.
A very long limbless arboreal serpent with muscular coils, angular head, gripping tail and crest scales; no legs.
A sentient alien mangrove tree with a single gnarled trunk torso, branch crown, hanging foliage, and six distinct stilt-like walking roots acting as legs; no humanoid face or human arms.
A compact hovering mechanical scout drone with faceted armored central hull, two side thruster pods, a sensor eye and one underslung manipulator or weapon; clearly airborne machine.
A squat polar burrower beast with elongated armored body, four digging limbs, shovel claws, and a massive conical drilling rostrum on its snout.
A broad winged snow-gliding alien manta with flat diamond body, two flexible lateral fins, long stabilizing tail and frosted dorsal ridges; no legs.
A heavy quadruped ice ram with four hoofed legs, thick neck, wedge skull, and two enormous translucent forward-curling glacier horns.
A large limbless polar annelid with segmented translucent body, circular toothed sucker mouth, tapered tail and internal cyan-violet bioluminescent organs; crawling on belly, never a snake with eyes.
A lean alien polar feline quadruped with four long paws, low hunting shoulders, long counterbalance tail, armored cheek plates and white-gray thermal fur.
A mobile alien plant organism with thick seed-pod body, glowing amber heat vents, three root-tentacle legs, two shorter tendrils and layered frost-resistant husk; no humanoid face.
One adult human scientist in sealed white-and-orange arctic field suit, hood and clear visor, compact sensor backpack and handheld xenobiology scanner; anatomically human.
An ancient bipedal alien frost machine with compact bronze-stone torso, two articulated arms, two sturdy reverse-jointed legs, single blue optical core and ice-encrusted rune-free plates.
A low amphibious alien reptile-fish built to skim molten lava, with streamlined plated body, wedge head, four broad heatproof paddle limbs, dorsal vents and a long flattened tail.
A muscular quadruped volcanic ram with four cloven legs, stocky shoulders, black cracked-basalt hide glowing dull orange in fissures, and two massive forward-curling stone horns.
A winged alien volcanic predator with two hind legs, two large membranous wings used as forelimbs, long tail, narrow reptilian skull and soot-black scales.

A young renegade Yautja hunter with tall muscular humanoid alien anatomy, mandible face partially visible, long dark dreadlock-like tendrils, sparse battered bronze armor, light netting, wrist blades and compact shoulder plasma caster.

A distinct veteran renegade Yautja hunter with tall muscular humanoid alien anatomy, mandible mask, long tied dreadlock-like tendrils, asymmetrical dark armor, wrist blades, visible folded capture net launcher, cable snares and trap canisters.

A lean amphibious alien feline quadruped adapted to delta reeds, with four webbed paws, low catlike shoulders, narrow predatory head, long reed-patterned counterbalance tail, gill frills and slick moss-green hide.
One adult human woman field surveyor in practical olive waterproof waders and light armored vest, tied hair under hood, compact backpack, handheld terrain scanner and one folded ranging staff.
One adult human man in mud-stained teal-and-tan sealed field suit, medical backpack with simple red-free white medical panels, compact diagnostic tool and bandage canisters.

A sleek amphibious xenomorph-like alien with elongated smooth domed skull, eyeless face, biomechanical ribbed torso, two arms, two digitigrade legs, long bladed tail, webbed claws and enlarged acid-spitting jaw sacs.

One corroded humanoid synthetic android in torn soaked utility coveralls, pale artificial skin split to expose white polymer musculature and metal joints, waterlogged cables and one glowing artificial eye.
